description: Capture a screenshot of any webpage, raw HTML, or Markdown. Returns the image as base64-encoded data. Supports custom viewport sizes, device emulation, dark mode, full-page capture, element targeting, CSS/JS injection, geolocation, stealth mode, PDF output, and more.

block_chats.description: Block live chat widgets (Intercom, Drift, etc.)

bypass_csp.description: Bypass Content Security Policy (allows CSS/JS injection on strict sites)

cache_ttl.description: Cache the screenshot for this many seconds (0 = no cache, max 86400 = 24h)

certified.description: Generate a certified screenshot with SHA-256 hash and timestamp

click_selector.description: CSS selector of an element to click before capture

clip.description: Clip a specific rectangle from the page (x, y, width, height in pixels)

cookies.description: Cookies to set before page load

css.description: Custom CSS to inject into the page

delay.description: Delay in seconds after page load before capturing

device.description: Device preset (affects viewport and user agent)

device_scale_factor.description: Custom device pixel ratio (0.5-4). Overrides retina setting

disable_animations.description: Disable all CSS animations and transitions

extract_metadata.description: Extract page metadata (title, description, OG tags, Twitter Card) alongside the screenshot

geolocation.description: Emulate geolocation (latitude, longitude, optional accuracy in meters)

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers as key-value pairs

hide_selectors.description: CSS selectors of elements to hide before capture

hover_selector.description: CSS selector of an element to hover before capture

html.description: Raw HTML to render and screenshot (alternative to url)

js.description: Custom JavaScript to execute before capture

markdown.description: Markdown content to render and screenshot (alternative to url)

navigation_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for initial page navigation

omit_background.description: Make the page background transparent (PNG/WebP only)

pdf_landscape.description: PDF in landscape orientation (only when format=pdf)

proxy.description: HTTP/SOCKS proxy URL for the request

resize_height.description: Resize output image to this height

resize_width.description: Resize output image to this width (maintains aspect ratio if only width given)

scroll_duration.description: Duration of scroll video in seconds (2-30)

scroll_to.description: CSS selector of an element to scroll into view before capture

scroll_video.description: Record a scrolling video of the page instead of a static screenshot

selector.description: CSS selector to capture a specific element instead of the full viewport

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode to avoid bot detection

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the page to load

url.description: URL of the page to screenshot (must start with http:// or https://)

wait_for_selector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before capturing

wait_until.description: When to consider the page loaded

name: take_screenshot
